name: greece-vat-return
description: Greek VAT (ΦΠΑ) for 2026 under the VAT Code ratified by ν. 5144/2024, which replaced ν. 2859/2000. Covers who is a taxable person, the 24%, 13%, 6% and 4% rates and the 30% island reduction from 1 January 2026, the EUR 10,000 small business exemption and the EU SME scheme (EUR 100,000 Union turnover), monthly and quarterly periodic returns, payment and the two-instalment option, input VAT and blocked costs, the reverse charge, intra-EU supplies and acquisitions, recapitulative statements, EU distance sales and OSS, refunds to foreign businesses, and the Tax Procedure Code fines for late or wrong returns. Trigger on "Greek VAT", "ΦΠΑ", "periodic VAT return Greece", "myAADE VAT", "Greek VAT rates 2026", "small business exemption Greece", "reverse charge Greece", "Greek island VAT".
